summary: Verified AdMob banner relocation from feud detail page to home feed with interleaving every 5 feuds. Static code review + live DOM verification via Playwright on web preview (chat_a-flavored anonymous session). All assertions pass: no ad-slot / ad-banner testIDs render on web home OR feud detail, no 'PUBBLICITÀ' label leaks on web, home renders feuds cleanly, feud detail loads with no AdBanner residue. No console errors. withAds logic + last-item guard reviewed in source and matches spec.
critical_code_review_comments: withAds() logic verified in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx L36-48: inserts ad row after every AD_INTERVAL=5 feuds AND guards against dangling last-item ad via `i !== feuds.length - 1`. Matches spec.
Web platform gate at L363-377: ad rows render `null` on Platform.OS==='web' — DOM confirmed 0 ad-slots and no 'PUBBLICITÀ' text (would have been visual noise).
keyExtractor uses discriminated union: feud.feud_id vs adId — no collisions possible (L345).

Feud detail /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/feud/[id].tsx: grep confirms `AdBanner` no longer imported nor rendered; the old testIDs `ad-banner-feud-detail`/`ad-placeholder-feud-detail` are absent from bundle. Comment at L483-485 documents the intentional removal.

Minor spec vs code note: review says feuds.length=6 -> 0 ads, but actual code inserts an ad AFTER 5th when feud #6 follows (guard only triggers when the 5th feud is also the last). Not a bug — the guard's purpose is 'no dangling terminal ad', which is what the code enforces. Behavior on native for len=6 is 5 feuds + ad + 6th feud.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing pre-seeded feuds (163 in category=all) via anonymous session created during test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Anonymous auth flow on web preview requires: (1) click ANONIMO to reveal nickname input, (2) enter nickname + click ENTRA COME ANONIMO, (3) scroll the ToS terms fully to reveal the ENABLED [data-testid=terms-accept-btn] (button disabled until scroll-to-bottom sentinel triggers), (4) click terms-accept-btn. Home lands on [data-testid=home-screen]. Feud cards carry data-testid=feud-card-<feudId>. AdMob ad rows on web are stripped (return null) so DOM has zero [data-testid^=ad-slot-] on web preview — expected behavior. Native ad slot testID format: 'ad-slot-ad-<N>' where N is position marker (1-indexed after N-th feud).
rca_of_issue: N/A — this iteration validates the AdMob relocation feature. Verified DOM: home=17 feud-cards / 0 ad-slots / 0 'PUBBLICITÀ' text; feud detail=0 old ad-banner testIDs / 0 ad-slots / 0 'PUBBLICITÀ' text; 0 console errors during flow.
